about_the_game: The official Brichi Quest soundtrack is more than just background music — it’s the heartbeat of your adventure. From serene landscapes to tense battles, each composition was crafted to capture the atmosphere of the world and guide you through its challenges. Whether you want to relive your favorite moments or discover the details hidden in each melody, these tracks will bring you right back into the heart of Brichi Quest. Perfect for listening on a journey, while working, or when you simply want to escape into another world.
